convert.description: Enable or disable automatic conversion of audio files (e.g., MP3→WAV). Default is yes.

cdtext.description: Enable or disable writing of CD-Text data to the TOC file. Default is yes.

quiet.description: Suppress warning messages (equivalent to -q option). Default is no.

converters.description: List of file conversion rules. Each entry specifies source extension, target extension, and shell command to perform conversion. Environment variables C2T_FROM and C2T_TO are available in the command.
